summary: Full-stack E2E validation of Custom Ruleset Editor + Regex Test Bench + purge pipelines. Backend: 42/42 pytest cases PASS (including test_custom_rules with 8 cases covering rule creation, deterministic hash, valid/invalid regex, ReDoS protection, pattern length limit, matching engine, detection integration & NER dedup). Frontend: 11/11 UI micro-checks PASS (open from header + badge, create/edit/duplicate/toggle/delete, valid & invalid regex Test Bench, save-blocked on invalid regex, close editor). E2E: seeded a custom rule via localStorage, loaded DEV/QA fixtures for both RRHH PDF and Legal DOCX. Custom entities (QA_PAYROLL, QA_LEGAL) detected in ReviewPanel; accept-all + purge modal + confirm-purge triggered irreversible purge; purge-result-verified-badge shown for both formats. Audit JSON contains ruleset.custom_ruleset_id, custom_ruleset_version, custom_ruleset_hash (sha256), active_custom_rules_count, detectors.custom_rules_active=true, per-item rule_id=custom.rule_qa1, and only sha256 hashes of raw text — zero plaintext leakage of DNI/email/phone/IBAN/salary tokens.

minor.issue: Race condition when parallel xdist workers both invoke generate_all_fixtures session fixture (shared .tmp.png path). Fixed by using unique tmp filenames with pid+uuid.

critical_code_review_comments: Custom ruleset audit metadata is well-modelled: deterministic SHA256 hash is order-invariant and pattern-sensitive, correctly surfaced in audit JSON alongside base_profile version — enables provenance audits.

CustomRulesetEditor stores rules in localStorage only (client-side). This is fine for on-prem/local processing model but should be documented; rules do not persist across browsers/users — acceptable for MVP.

The QA plan referenced data-testids 'fixture-card-legal', 'fixture-card-rrhh' but the actual DOM emits 'load-fixture-legal-btn' / 'load-fixture-rrhh-btn'. Not a bug but should be reconciled in QA docs.

The Header 'active_custom_rules_badge' in UploadScreen previously lacked the data-testid attribute called out in the QA plan. Added data-testid='active_custom_rules_badge' to the badge button so future automation can target it.
App.js still contains 'http://localhost:8001' fallback for REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — carry-over from prior iterations; violates fail-fast env policy but out of scope for this review.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (11/11 UI checks + PDF + DOCX E2E purge)

seed_data_creation: Custom rules injected via window.localStorage.setItem('anclora_custom_rules', ...). DEV/QA fixtures generated by backend fixtures_generator (HR PDF, Legal DOCX). Purged docs and audit JSON left in ephemeral /tmp/anclora-purgedoc session dirs (auto-clean on TTL).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression command: `cd /app && PYTHONPATH=/app python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v` (42 tests, ~53s, 2 xdist workers). Custom rules seeded in localStorage key 'anclora_custom_rules' (JSON array). DEV/QA fixtures button uses data-testid='qa-fixtures-btn'; fixture load buttons use 'load-fixture-{id}-btn' (NOT fixture-card-{id}). Audit JSON downloadable at GET /api/documents/{doc_id}/audit.json — contains ruleset.custom_ruleset_hash and per-item sha256 hashes only.
rca of the issue: Only one flaky race found: parallel pytest-xdist workers collided on shared .tmp.png filename inside fixtures_generator._save_image_as_pdf. When two workers concurrently generated raster fixtures, worker A unlinked the tmp file before worker B loaded it, triggering pymupdf.FileNotFoundError. Fixed by using unique tmp filenames incorporating pid+uuid. Re-run confirms 42/42 pass consistently. No product-level bugs.
